name: Andaz Amsterdam, Prinsengracht
insider_take: This converted public library turned luxury hotel sits on Amsterdam's most famous canal, where literary history meets modern Dutch design in the most unexpected way.
whats_special: The Andaz Amsterdam occupies a stunning 1913 former public library building, complete with original Art Nouveau details and soaring reading room ceilings. Located directly on the UNESCO-protected Prinsengracht canal, it's positioned in the heart of the historic Jordaan district, just steps from the Anne Frank House and the vibrant Nine Streets shopping area.
pro_tip: Book a canal-view room on the Prinsengracht side – you'll wake up to houseboats, historic gables, and the gentle sound of canal traffic right outside your window.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop garden offers panoramic views over Amsterdam's canal ring, while the lobby's original library features and massive windows create Instagram-worthy moments. The location puts you within walking distance of the Westerkerk (where Rembrandt is buried) and the famous Saturday Noordermarkt.
pros: Prime canal-side location in historic Prinsengracht district
Contemporary design blending modern luxury with Dutch heritage
Hyatt Privé benefits including room upgrades and VIP amenities
Exceptional locally-inspired dining and craft cocktail program
cons: Historic canal location may have limited parking availability
